title: Splice formulae for Poincaré series of integral homology spheres
summary: Let M be a plumbed integral homology sphere 3-manifold associated with a connected negative definite plumbing graph $Γ$. One of its most important invariants is its multivariable Poincaré series (or zeta function) $f_Γ(\mathbf {t})$. Several numerical invariants can be read from $f_Γ(\mathbf{t})$, or even from its `polynomial part' $ \operatorname{Pol}_Γ(\mathbf{t})$. For example, the `normalized' Casson's invariant equals $ \operatorname{Pol}_Γ(1)$.
